access_evidence: GET /data/timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs?... returned HTTP 200 but redirected to https://api.census.gov/data/missing_key.html (8,764 B) — the key-required page. The variable dictionary /variables.json returned 200 JSON, so the schema is public even though values are not.

name: US Census Bureau — International Trade API (HS time series)
notes: The brief described this endpoint as 'keyless for limited use'. On 2026-11-10 it is not: the redirect to missing_key.html is unambiguous.
rate_policy: Key required; key signup page answered HTTP 200 (10,287 B).
unlock_route: Free self-service API key at https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html and send it as ?key=; then /timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs becomes usable (COMM_LVL=HS4, I_COMMODITY=9018).
what_is_new: Nothing collected: the value path is keyed. This is a clean negative.
